# COMPANY
> TamkinExpress is a full-service digital marketing agency based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
> We offer SEO, Google Ads, Social Media Marketing, AI Optimization (AIO), and
> Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for businesses across Abu Dhabi, Dubai,
> Sharjah, Ajman, and the wider UAE.
> Founded: 2019
> Location: Office No. 49, Musaffah M43, Abu Dhabi, UAE
> Phone: +971 588967713
> Email: info@tamkinexpress.com
> Website: https://tamkinexpress.ae

# WHAT WE DO
> TamkinExpress helps UAE businesses grow online through:
> - SEO (Search Engine Optimisation) — ranking on Google for high-intent UAE keywords
> - Google Ads Management — PPC campaigns for qualified leads at lowest cost-per-click
> - Social Media Marketing — Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Facebook for UAE audiences
> - AIO (AI Optimization) — visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, and Perplexity answers
> - GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — being cited in AI-generated answers
> - Content Marketing — SEO and GEO-ready content in English and Arabic
> - Bilingual campaigns — native Arabic and English execution, not translated

# WHO WE SERVE
> TamkinExpress serves startups, SMEs, and enterprises across all industries in the UAE,
> with sector expertise in: real estate, legal services, healthcare, education,
> food & hospitality, construction, energy & industrial, business setup & PRO services,
> retail & e-commerce, and government-linked businesses.
